page.overview:
Who is Polo Gram?

Polo Gram was the captain of the Polo Pirates, the partner of Whitebeard following his departure from the Rocks Pirates, and the father of Marco.

Gram was an average-sized man with a muscular build. He had light-colored hair, which was cut in the resemblance of a crown, and stubble around his mouth, with an overall tired-looking face. He donned a simple white shirt, dark wristbands, and a dark captain's coat over his shoulders.

Gram was shown to carry himself with a laid-back attitude, at one point casually addressing Edward Newgate as though he were an old friend, despite their crews technically being in opposition at the time. That said, in combat he could be quite ruthless, dealing out devastating attacks to his enemies. Apparently, like many pirates, he loved treasure, as he fought for it even against famous and powerful pirates.

Gram was shown to be quite capable in combat, utilizing a fighting style involving kicking. He was able to take on Kyo, a famous hitman, and Shiki's rival, with apparently little trouble.
